description: Source code for TinyMCE plugin handling Flash embedding, including functions for initializing the plugin UI, generating HTML for Flash files, and inserting Flash objects into content.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Flash plugin dialog, sets up form fields, and pre-selects the current Flash file.

methods.name: getFlashListHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for a dropdown list of available Flash files if the list is defined.

methods.name: insertFlash
methods.description: Inserts a Flash object into the editor content based on form inputs.
